hotspots.title: Trump's united Ireland remarks spark unionist backlash
hotspots.blurb: Donald Trump's explicit endorsement of Irish unification during his trip to Ireland has ignited fierce political commentary across diplomatic and media channels. Trump claimed he 'loved' the backlash to his comments, framing his intervention as part of an anti-colonial foreign policy shift while also offering tariff relief on Irish whiskey.
hotspots.affect: The story commands extreme affective investment due to cross-border geopolitical controversy, anti-colonial ideological posturing, and high-profile presidential defiance of traditional diplomatic norms.

hotspots.title: Clash over AI regulation and US-China tech dominance
hotspots.blurb: A high-stakes battle over artificial intelligence regulation has pitted the Trump administration and tech leaders against Democrats and safety advocates like Anthropic. Trump insists that slowing down AI development would cede vital technological leadership to China, declaring 'whoever wins AI wins.'
hotspots.affect: Generates strong affective investment through existential geopolitical panic over Chinese dominance combined with intense ideological clashes over tech regulation.

hotspots.title: Trump's proposed $5,000 dividend faces skepticism and backlash
hotspots.blurb: Trump's proposal to issue $5,000 'dividend' checks to Americans has met resistance from congressional leaders and harsh criticism from opponents. House Speaker Mike Johnson emphasized that any such payout requires congressional approval, while critics denounce the promise as an unfeasible electoral ploy.
hotspots.affect: Commands attention through populist economic promises balanced against intra-party caution and sharp accusations of political demagoguery.

hotspots.title: State lawsuits and court rulings challenge Trump administration policies
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration faces a surge of legal challenges from state officials, landowners, and federal judges. Recent rulings and lawsuits have blocked orders cutting FEMA staffing, challenged border wall construction in Texas, and targeted proposed green card public charge restrictions.
hotspots.affect: Drives engagement through continuous legal friction, rights-based indignation, and constitutional battles over executive authority.

hotspots.title: Trump agrees to ethics rules for crypto bill
hotspots.blurb: President Trump has agreed to new ethics concessions, including restrictions on meme coin issuances, to help pass the landmark Clarity Act in the Senate. The negotiations have sparked intense debate among crypto advocates, policy advisers, and ethics critics over whether the guardrails are sufficient.
hotspots.affect: Generates focused heat over financial conflict-of-interest concerns, legislative compromise, and high-stakes crypto sector regulation.
